title: Ordinary etale identifications and canonical overlap transport
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $F$ an algebraic space over $S$, with its small etale site and structure sheaf [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Module sheaves are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a scheme map $a$, write $a^*$ for tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], with the section pullback unit and unit-normalized composition comparisons of [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. For scheme maps $p:Y\to Z$, $f:X\to Y$, $p':X\to Z$ with $pf=p'$ and an ordinary module $L$ on $Z$, define the section restriction $\rho_{f,p}:\Gamma(Y,p^*L)\to\Gamma(X,p'^*L)$ by pulling back sections along $f$, applying the canonical composition comparison, and transporting along $pf=p'$. For a chart $V\to F$, a module $N$ on $F$ and an ordinary module $L$ on $V$, an ordinary etale identification is a family of $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$-linear equivalences $a_{T,p}:\Gamma(T,p^*L)\simeq N(T)$ for every chart arrow $p:T\to V$, satisfying $a_{T',pf}(\rho_{f,p}(m))=N(f)(a_{T,p}(m))$ for every chart arrow $f:T'\to T$. Also, for schemes $X,Y,R,T$, ordinary modules $L$ on $X$ and $K$ on $Y$, maps $p:R\to X$, $q:R\to Y$, and an isomorphism $\alpha:q^*K\simeq p^*L$, define its transport along $r:T\to R$ and equations $pr=a$, $qr=b$ to be the isomorphism $b^*K\simeq a^*L$ obtained from $r^*\alpha$ by the same canonical composition comparisons and equality transports. For schemes over $S$, use this construction on their underlying schemes, retaining their leg equations over $S$. These constructions assume neither invertibility nor a descent theorem.
